kv22.2:2.3: arahā ācinanto apacinanto pajahanto upādiyanto visinento ussinento vidhūpento saṃdhūpento parinibbāyatī”ti.

kv22.2:2.9: nanu arahā neva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito …pe… neva visineti na ussineti visinetvā ṭhito …pe…
kv22.2:2.10: nanu arahā neva vidhūpeti na saṃdhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito’ti.
kv22.2:2.12: hañci arahā neva vidhūpeti na saṃdhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito. no ca vata re vattabbe
kv22.2:3.4: nanu arahā upaṭṭhitasati sato sampajāno parinibbāyatī’ti.
kv22.2:3.6: hañci arahā upaṭṭhitasati sato sampajāno parinibbāyati. tena vata re vattabbe
